# ZYZ Capital

> ZYZ Capital Limited (ZYZ Capital LTD) is an international online multi-asset brokerage company incorporated in Saint Lucia (Registration No. 2024-00712), offering forex, metals, energies, cash indices and CFD trading on MetaTrader 5.

ZYZ Capital provides execution-only access to global markets for clients across the Gulf and Middle East, Africa, South Asia and Southeast Asia. Accounts start from $10. Swap-free Islamic accounts are available on request.

Official website: https://www.zyzcapitalltd.com/
Open a live account: https://my.zyzcapitalltd.com/live_signup
Client login: https://my.zyzcapitalltd.com/login
WebTrader: https://web.metatrader.app/terminal

## Facts

- Legal name: ZYZ Capital Limited
- Brand: ZYZ Capital
- Incorporation: Saint Lucia International Business Company
- Registration number: 2024-00712
- Registered office: Ground Floor, The Sotheby Building, Rodney Village, Rodney Bay, Gros-Islet, Saint Lucia
- Email: info@zyzcapitalltd.com
- Platform: MetaTrader 5 (web, Windows, Android, iOS)
- Minimum deposit: $10 (Standard), $5,000 (Pro), $20,000 (Bullion)
- Account currency: USD

## Countries served

- Gulf & Middle East: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan
- Africa: Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana, Egypt, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia
- South Asia: Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal
- Southeast Asia: Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam

## Restricted jurisdictions

Afghanistan, Congo, Haiti, Iran, Kenya, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Myanmar, North Korea (DPRK), Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Syria, Venezuela, Yemen, and any jurisdiction where offering these services would violate applicable law.
